definitions.name: AirVPN
steps: Sign in at airvpn.org and open Client Area › Config Generator.
Choose Linux and WireGuard, pick a country or server, and generate the file.
Upload it here. To forward a port, reserve one under Client Area › Forwarded ports and type it below.

definitions.name: IVPN
steps: Sign in at ivpn.net and open the Client Area’s WireGuard configuration generator. It needs an account id like i-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
Generate a key, pick a server, and download the file.
Upload it here.

definitions.name: Mullvad
steps: Sign in at mullvad.net and open WireGuard configuration.
Generate a key for this server, pick a country and server, and download the file.
Upload it here.

definitions.name: Another WireGuard provider
steps: Download a WireGuard configuration file from your provider. It needs a DNS line in its [Interface] section.
Upload it here. If they reserved a port for you, type it below.

definitions.name: Private Internet Access
steps: Use the username and password you sign in to PIA with. The username starts with p.
Pick a region. highsea registers its own WireGuard key with PIA, so there’s no file.

definitions.name: Proton VPN
steps: Sign in at account.protonvpn.com and open Downloads › WireGuard configuration.
Choose a server marked P2P (the double arrow), and turn on NAT-PMP (port forwarding).
Download the file and upload it here.

definitions.name: Surfshark
steps: Sign in at my.surfshark.com and open VPN › Manual setup › Desktop or mobile › WireGuard.
Generate a key pair (save it, Surfshark won’t show it again), choose a location, and download the file.
Upload it here.

definitions.name: Windscribe
steps: Sign in at windscribe.com and open My Account › Config Generator › WireGuard. It needs a paid account.
Choose a location and port 443, keep New Key Pair, and download the file.
Upload it here. To forward a port, open My Account › Port Forwarding, request an ephemeral port with Matching Port, and type it below. It lasts 7 days.
